geographic_scope: Comuna 8 / Villa Hermosa, Medellín. Current proving ground remains Llanaditas / upper Comuna 8. Moravia is not a target of this registry.
guardrail: This layer traces published local planning and research. It is not community endorsement, not a numeric local calibration, and not a substitute for co-design.

entries.plan_action: Household and neighborhood rainwater capture as a water-management / hillside-load reduction measure already present in Comuna 8 adaptation practice.
prerequisites: Roof access and storage specification agreed with residents
Maintenance and training arrangements before treating capture as durable
entries.evidence_gap: No transferable Comuna 8 unit cost or locally calibrated slope-benefit coefficient is encoded in the optimizer.

entries.plan_action: Surface-water management and drainage works as part of neighborhood climate-risk reduction, not as a standalone early-warning product.
prerequisites: Corridor and outlet conditions confirmed in the field
Everyday access and care routes reviewed before construction
entries.evidence_gap: Mapped drainage-corridor proxy is not drainage capacity. Hydraulic design remains an engineering follow-up.

entries.plan_action: Nature-based / bioengineering slope work aligned with published informal-area climate-resilience guidance.
entries.geographic_scope: Informal and marginalized hillside settlements, applied here only as documentary typology alignment
prerequisites: Species, tenure and maintenance capacity agreed locally
Maturity delay acknowledged; year-1 effect is not full prior effect
entries.evidence_gap: UN-Habitat guidance is not a Medellín species list or a calibrated restoration effect range.

entries.plan_action: Community organization in Comuna 8 has a documented path from protest to proposal; Ourea treats that as a participation-design lesson, not as a completed consultation record.
prerequisites: Legitimate representatives identified in the pilot
Veto criteria recorded without converting them into hidden optimizer weights
entries.evidence_gap: No organization is named as a confirmed Ourea partner. Absence of community_evidence.json means not assessed.
